name: MoEngage Data Export
shortInfo: Data that can be exported from User Segments, User Events & Campaign Reports.
brief: MoEngage Data Export can export user events and campaign events that have been received or generated by MoEngage. It supports integration with the Amazon S3 buckets that allow MoEngage to share an hourly export of required data in JSON format. The advantage of using the MoEngage Data Export connector is that you can send customised data from your selected apps to your Redshift, BigQuery and Snowflake Data Warehouses.
about:
Export the Email Id of users, who were engaged but uninstalled and run re-engagement campaigns on Facebook. Export phone numbers of inactive users and send them an SMS to reactivate them.  
Learn more about [MoEngage Data Export API documentation.](https://help.moengage.com/hc/en-us/articles/205424326-User-Data-Exports#run-export-0-0)
